title: ConvoLearn: A Dataset of Constructivist Tutor-Student Dialogue
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It introduces 'ConvoLearn', a dataset designed to evaluate and train AI tutors on constructivist, knowledge-building dialogue in the context of middle school Earth Science.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
